listing.name: Grounded Portrait Pack 1.1.0
listing.summary: A simple portrait pack, made from concept art and game assets from different IPs, edited into one grounded package that hopefully remains compatible with the vanilla aesthetic.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 45 grounded portraits edited from various sci-fi IPs to replace or supplement vanilla portraits.

description:
A simple portrait pack, made from concept art and game assets from different IPs, edited into one grounded package that hopefully remains compatible with the vanilla aesthetic.No AI Generation. Just as Brother Cotton intended.

Download Here

Repo Here

No art was made by me, all credit to the original artists. All I did was cobble some cool looking art into portraits. I used

GIMP

to edit everything. This is my first mod for well, anything actually.

1.1.0 Release

- Now 45 Portraits, added mostly from Dead Space and Cyberpunk, up from 26

- Edited existing portraits to look better

- New naming conventions for better sorting and future-proofing

- Standardised faction seperation for better continuity and additional future-proofing

- Version Checker enabled

correctly

for TriOS, etc.

Shoutout to

Chozo's Battletech Portrait pack

for being the inspiration as well as

Vexlia Artemiss

for their advice.

Previous changelogs:

Spoiler

1.0.0

Current selection of a measley 26 new portraits with plenty of ideas to expand. Future plans are to separate portraits between low / med / high tech aligned factions when there's more bulk e.g. more Highfleet-esq style for Pirate & Pathers, MENACE & Titanfall for Heg & Persean, so on and so forth. This way, the more diverse styles can still flourish in their respective themes as well as some simple thematic recolours.

aiDescription: Adds a collection of 45 portraits edited from concept art and game assets from franchises like Dead Space, Cyberpunk, and Halo. The pack aims to maintain compatibility with the vanilla aesthetic without using AI generation. Portraits are organized by tech level and gender presentation for easier faction customization.
